title: Dessert Making Workshop
summary: A hands-on Dessert Making Workshop was organised for 50 women to promote culinary skills, creativity, and self-reliance.
description: A hands-on Dessert Making Workshop was organised for 50 women to promote culinary skills, creativity, and self-reliance. The club provided expert trainers and all necessary raw materials, enabling participants to learn practical dessert-making techniques and explore opportunities for skill development and income generation.
location: Centre for the Study of Social Change (CSSC), Mumbai, Maharashtra
